packet.objective: Implement read-only artifact analysis, claim readiness contract and evidence-based quality checklist assets

acceptance.text: Read-only deterministic analysis reports located clarification, requirement coverage, dependency, scope, command and declared lens defects against production artifact templates; input errors never become PASS.

Analysis separates factual findings from semantic review still needed, exports claim readiness for applicable scales, and preserves files and project state even on malformed, unsafe or nonregular inputs.

Four packaged quality checklist templates and native governance instructions preserve evidence-only checkoffs, read-only analysis, scale requirements, and explicit remediation without silently changing artifacts.

findings.message: Resolved in fix round 1: preimplementation analysis now identity-binds exact story-declared .sdd files at every scale and reports missing or invalid contracts. Large/regulated stages require the phase-appropriate constitution, spec/plan/story checklists, SpecDD policy/bootstrap and declared story contracts while explicitly excluding later verification and wiki artifacts. Semantic prompts require judgment of checklist evidence and contract coverage rather than treating presence as PASS.

review.summary: Independent complete re-review verified the corrected scale and contract readiness inputs, bounded read-only behavior, factual/semantic separation, checklist packaging and exact-snapshot gates. The prior major is resolved. Actual first-claim runtime consumption remains deliberately assigned to T08.

criteria.evidence: Independent inspection and tests verify located deterministic findings for clarification, FR/AC plan/story coverage, dependency errors and cycles, overlapping parallel scope, malformed/missing commands and gates, mandatory declared lenses, approval drift, malformed stories and missing/invalid required preimplementation artifacts. Input uncertainty remains UNKNOWN and semantic risk/architecture candidates remain judgment-required rather than factual PASS claims.

The analyzer is bounded and read-only, separates factual findings from explicit semantic prompts, and exports story-scoped claim readiness identities. Corrected analysis binds constitution, exact phase checklist paths, SpecDD bootstrap and every exact strict-parser-declared .sdd file; changed contract bytes change content and analysis identities, missing files block, and nonregular inputs become UNKNOWN. A targeted independent complete large fixture reached factual CLEAR/REVIEW_REQUIRED, while the missing-prerequisite fixture is BLOCKED without demanding completion evidence. Runtime claim wiring is correctly deferred to T08.

Four installed checklist templates remain unchecked evidence contracts with fixed destinations, concrete evidence fields and remediation/UNKNOWN guidance. Governance now documents phase-appropriate large/regulated checklist and contract inventory, exact content identity, no wildcard discovery or installation, read-only behavior, and the rule that file or checkbox presence is not semantic PASS. Coordinator npm test and npm run validate passed at frozen snapshot 823d14c5c7a5566376e2fc3ad2adef00bb3b38bce6cb9927372eef261aee9949 with no scope drift.

events.reason: Independent review found missing large/regulated preimplementation readiness prerequisites and ignored declared SpecDD contract inputs, allowing stale semantic evidence.
